notes: Derived from: Gemma4 runner: full-input N4 and largest-tool-result supervisors. hf2q defaults: the full-input checkpoint (ADR-063) and, since v0.1.30, the four release-gate routes (decode attention NE 4, row_exact decode dense, tensor warm attention, Q5_0 tensor matmul) are defaults, so the empty variables below run the gate configuration.
Override any variable with HF2Q_Q5_<NAME>; null variables are required. See scripts/four_agent/README.md.

A/B of the Gemma full-input checkpoint: HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_FULL_INPUT_CHECKPOINT=0 selects the kill switch (forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_FULL_INPUT_CHECKPOINT=0); the empty default leaves the hf2q default. Use a distinct --output per arm.

A/B of Gemma joint warm prefill (ADR-063 Stage 1): HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_JOINT_WARM_PREFILL=0 selects the kill switch (forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_JOINT_WARM_PREFILL=0, per-slot warm prefill); the empty default leaves the hf2q default (on). Use a distinct --output per arm.

A/B of Gemma joint cold prefill (ADR-063 Q4-GEMMA-COLD): HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_JOINT_COLD_PREFILL=0 selects the kill switch (forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_JOINT_COLD_PREFILL=0, per-slot cold turn-0 admission); the empty default leaves the hf2q default (on). Use a distinct --output per arm.

A/B of Gemma warm-prefill attention (ADR-063 Stage 2): HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_WARM_TILED_ATTENTION=0 selects the kill switch (vec-hybrid warm attention), =1 tiled F16 and =tensor the tensor-API route (forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_WARM_TILED_ATTENTION); the empty default leaves the hf2q default (the tensor-API route since v0.1.30; vec-hybrid before). Experiment arms set HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_WARM_ATTENTION_KERNEL to the arm's resolved kernel (TensorF16 for the default or tensor, VecHybrid for 0, TiledF16 for 1): readiness then requires measurement_snapshot.active_controls.gemma_warm_attention_kernel to equal it, so the receipt binds its arm. The empty default skips that check (recorded, not compared), so stock binaries that do not publish the field (v0.1.28) still pass readiness. Use a distinct --output per arm.

A/B of the Gemma prefill MoE down route (ADR-063 Q4-GEMMA-PREFILL-MOE): HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_PREFILL_MOE_DOWN=flat|slotted is forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_PREFILL_MOE_DOWN (flat is the previous flattened route, the A arm); HF2Q_Q5_MM_ID_SCHEDULE=grid|compact is forwarded as HF2Q_MM_ID_SCHEDULE (mlx-native expert-matmul tile schedule; grid is the A arm once the compact schedule ships). The empty defaults leave the hf2q and native defaults. The arm is recorded in /hf2q/v1/runtime active_controls.gemma_prefill_moe_down. Use a distinct --output per arm.

Gemma Q5_0 tensor matmul (mlx-native #99): HF2Q_Q5_Q5_0_TENSOR_MM=0 selects the kill switch (simdgroup route) and =1 the tensor pipeline explicitly (forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_Q5_0_TENSOR_MM; it rejects any other value). The empty default leaves the hf2q default: on for Gemma 4 since v0.1.30, off before (a v0.1.29 launcher accepts only 1). The arm is recorded in /hf2q/v1/runtime active_controls.q5_0_tensor_mm. Use a distinct --output per arm.

V2 decode-workload diagnostic (ADR-063 Q4-GEMMA-DECODE §7.4): HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_ROUTING_OVERLAP=1 is forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_ROUTING_OVERLAP=1 and prints [ROUTING_OVERLAP] histograms at worker exit; the empty default leaves it off. Untimed runs only.

A/B of the Gemma decode attention head split (ADR-063 gap program): HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_DECODE_ATTN_NE=0 selects the kill switch (stock decode attention) and =4 or =2 that NE head split of every d256 decode attention dispatch (forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_DECODE_ATTN_NE); the empty default leaves the hf2q default (NE 4 since v0.1.30, stock before). The arm is recorded in /hf2q/v1/runtime active_controls.gemma_decode_attn_ne (Stock, Ne2 or Ne4).

A/B of the Gemma decode dense kernel (ADR-063 Q4-GEMMA-DECODE): HF2Q_Q5_GEMMA_DECODE_DENSE=stock|row_exact|mma is forwarded by the launcher as HF2Q_GEMMA_DECODE_DENSE; stock is the kill switch and the empty default leaves the hf2q default (row_exact since v0.1.30, stock before). The resolved arm is recorded in /hf2q/v1/runtime active_controls.gemma_decode_dense_kernel.

The client is the checked-in canonical four-agent coding workload. Q5 requires the largest declared workload: if the operator declares a larger one (e.g. largest prompt or tool result), copy this case and replace client.argv.

Text-only: a nonexistent MMPROJ makes the launcher omit --mmproj (it would otherwise default to a repo projector path), and hf2q serve then auto-loads the sibling gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-hf2q-q4_k_m-mmproj.gguf (observed in the 2026-10-30 calibration). artifact.text_only_locator serves a hard link of the same file from a private {OUT}/text-model/ directory, and readiness requires vision_projector == false.
